title: An Act Regarding Maine's Cannabis Industry

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to amend the laws governing the cannabis industry.

status_label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310

final_disposition.label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310

chamber_actions.action: Received by the Clerk of the House on January 30, 2025.
